cleared.check: Erigon v3.8.2 key and address intern caches in front of the storage read (execution/vm/evm.go:113-225 at tag v3.8.2, fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com): storageKeyCache indexed by the XOR of the four limbs, addressCache by limbs 0, 1 and the low half of limb 2.
cleared.result: A storage key hit needs the whole stored word to equal the stack word (c.words[i] == *word). An address hit compares limbs 0 and 1 and the low 32 bits of limb 2, the 20 bytes Bytes20 reads, and the stored word is kept with the upper bits cleared, so two words with the same low 20 bytes share the address they both name and no two addresses share an entry. Both caches are per EVM and never return a handle for another key.
